source_version.content: I found the earlier **parallel-edition requirement**, but not a recoverable file containing Greek for all 114 sayings. That distinction matters: only parts of Thomas survive in Greek, so the revised page will mark each Greek field as **extant Oxyrhynchus Greek**, **fragmentary**, or **no Greek witness**, rather than presenting a modern back-translation as manuscript text.
